title: polypodium phyllitidis var. repens
intro: Polypodium phyllitidis var. repens, commonly known as the Creeping Polypody, is a type of fern native to tropical and subtropical regions of the world. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Creeping Polypody include its ability to reduce fever, relieve coughs, and soothe irritated throats. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
